text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...! Power is overflowing... my whole 
body is tingling..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, right this moment... I wish to run 
alongside someone else..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Hotter, much fiercer... As if devouring 
each other...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, how unseemly of me...! To act like 
this in front of the Three Goddesses...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I will not let this power go to waste... I 
will reach even greater heights...!
